chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the washing for major impurity (ghusl al-janabah), so he said: 'Begin with your two palms and wash them, then wash your private part, then pour water upon your head three times, then pour water upon the rest of your body twice. Whatever the water flows upon has been purified.'
ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step method for performing ghusl al-janabah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah method of ghusl, emphasizing the sequential pouring of water (dalak) over the body rather than full immersion, a view favored by many Shia jurists. It highlights the practical application of purification by ensuring water reaches all parts of the body, culminating in the declaration that whatever the water has touched is purified. This procedure reflects the Prophetic tradition as transmitted through the Imams, providing a clear, step-by-step guide for ritual cleanliness.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) who said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about washing for the sexual impurity, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Begin with your two palms, then wash your private part. Then pour water upon your head three times, then pour the water upon the rest of your body, twice. So whatever the water flows upon, so it has been purified’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan all from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I asked one of the two Imam, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about Ghusl (bath) because of sexual relation. He (the Imam) said, ’Begin with your palms (hands) and wash them. Thereafter wash your private parts, then pour water over your head three times, then pour water over the rest of your body twice; over whatever parts water flows, they become clean.’”
